# Version 4.153.2
> **Failed flush cache cleanup** · Released October 12, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.153.2) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.153.2)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.153.2/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.302/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.153.2 clears uniquely held Ganesh cache entries after failed flushes.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Failed flushes no longer leave reusable uninitialized cache textures** — Drops uniquely held thread-safe-cache entries after unsuccessful GPU work so later draws cannot reuse those entries. Entries still held elsewhere are not removed. ([#5265](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5265))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.302

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.
